aboutGame.title: What is Ragdoll Reality?
paragraphs: Ragdoll Reality is a physics sandbox on Roblox from creator I am eating. Every hit is location-based: strike a leg and a dummy limps or crawls, hit an arm and it hangs while the dummy protects the wound, and heavier impacts can stagger, dismember, or cause bleeding.

The experience combines a dummy testing area, a playground full of hazards, and a graveyard where dummies rise as zombies. More than 20 weapons, including firearms, melee tools, and explosives, unlock through kills, while the Horde mode adds slow, normal, and fast enemies that chase, pounce, and bite.

modules.name: Ragdoll Reality Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with the dummy testing sandbox, learn Fists, Push, and Grab, and build a repeatable first session before moving on to weapons and hazards.

highlights.detail: Pick one dummy, one weapon, and a familiar close range.
Aim at one body area and watch the first reaction instead of only checking whether the dummy falls.
Change only the weapon, distance, target, or tempo in each new trial.
Practice leg, arm, torso, and head hits until the result is repeatable.
Move to one playground hazard, then the graveyard, only after your aim holds.

modules.name: Ragdoll Reality Zombie Horde Guide
modules.description: Follow the graveyard conversion loop, read the three zombie speed classes, and prepare a controlled Horde attempt.

highlights.detail: Watch the graveyard conversion zone before you attack anything.
Grab or launch a dummy into the zone and let it rise as a zombie.
Identify whether the new zombie moves at slow, normal, or fast speed.
Keep moving during a wave so speed classes separate and pounces stay visible.
Use the Horde button only after you can read one conversion cleanly.

highlights.label: Spike Pit

highlights.label: Cannon

highlights.label: Seesaw
highlights.detail: Use counterweight and timing to control how the dummy leaves the platform.

highlights.label: Tower

highlights.label: Mouse

highlights.label: Space

highlights.label: Reset

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Ragdoll Reality.

items.question: What is Ragdoll Reality?
items.answer: Ragdoll Reality is a Roblox physics sandbox where dummies react to the exact body area you hit. Legs can limp or crawl, arms can hang, and heavy impacts can stagger, dismember, or cause bleeding.

items.question: How do you unlock weapons in Ragdoll Reality?
items.answer: Ragdoll Reality awards new weapons as you earn kills. The official description lists Fists, Push, Grab, Pistol, Bat, Machete, Shotgun, Sniper, Minigun, Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, and C4.

items.question: How do you start a zombie horde in Ragdoll Reality?
items.answer: Throw a dummy into the Ragdoll Reality graveyard and watch it rise as a zombie. Once you understand the conversion and the slow, normal, and fast speed classes, use the Horde button to begin a wave.

items.question: Does Ragdoll Reality have codes?
items.answer: No public Ragdoll Reality codes are listed at this time. Check the official Roblox experience page for announcements before trusting reward lists from other sites.

items.question: What should beginners practice first in Ragdoll Reality?
items.answer: Start with one dummy, one weapon, and close range. Test the legs, arms, torso, and head separately, then change only one variable per trial so every Ragdoll Reality reaction has a clear cause.
